title: Bonnybridge UFO hotspot and stepfather's sightings

tellings.quote: he used to live in Faluk which is near Bonnybridge which is in Scotland and it's like a Scottish UFO hotspot. Had many many sightings almost like a tourist attraction. You know people go there to see UFOs

plain: Bonnybridge, in Scotland, is a UFO hotspot with so many sightings it is "almost like a tourist attraction," and the stepfather of the hacker Gary McKinnon lived nearby in Falkirk and had sightings of his own. McKinnon, who broke into US military and NASA computers looking for UFO files, tells Michels this as what his stepfather told him, placing it around 2000. It is part of how he explains his own interest in UFOs.
